variants.headline: A company goes under
variants.body: A company has gone under in {colony}. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Business failure enters the colony's record
variants.body: The colony has seen a company fail. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: An enterprise reaches failure
variants.body: A business in the colony has gone under. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
